sourcePolicy.reason: v0.1 isolates renderer/theme/composition evaluation from licensing, provenance, and domain-validity questions. A separately sourced real-data scene can be added after the corpus composition is proven.

sceneTiers.showcase: Eligible for a public specimen montage if the rendered result passes editorial/accessibility review.
sceneTiers.showcase_candidate: Evaluated at lab and compact scales, but does not enter the accepted eight-scene montage unless independently rated strong.
sceneTiers.stress: Intentionally probes a known edge or denser condition. Do not surface as a product claim merely because it renders.

scenes.title: Storm response across five watershed sites
scenes.question: Can five semantic site identities remain readable through different peak timings and partially overlapping recovery curves?

scenes.title: Circadian phase shift
scenes.question: Can phase shifts, crossings, and a damped waveform remain distinguishable without turning the figure into a color legend exercise?

scenes.title: Signed recovery after perturbation
scenes.question: Can the renderer preserve zero crossings and six identities when several trajectories converge toward baseline?

scenes.title: Instrument calibration agreement
scenes.question: Can small between-instrument offsets remain visible without obscuring the shared linear relationship?

scenes.title: Dose-response plate
scenes.question: Can five saturating response families be compared without implying a linear model?

scenes.title: Particle size and settling response
scenes.question: Does the figure make heteroscedasticity and one high-leverage observation visible rather than smoothing them away?

scenes.title: Treatment response distributions
scenes.question: Can center and spread be read together without letting the median summary erase the individual observations?

scenes.title: Response across ten habitat classes
scenes.question: Can Figurestead show ten categorical distributions with varied centers and spreads while keeping the categorical structure, individual observations, summaries, and axis labels readable at useful compact sizes?

scenes.title: Response distribution across habitat classes
scenes.question: What does Figurestead's existing Categorical response matrix look like when it has enough real structure to compare, rather than only enough cells to demonstrate that the renderer exists?

scenes.title: Inter-laboratory precision
scenes.question: Can a point-only distribution figure communicate precision differences when the centers are almost identical?

scenes.title: Seasonal habitat distributions
scenes.question: Can two semantic series remain comparable inside each categorical group while seasonal shifts remain obvious?

scenes.title: Field sampling coverage, 2020–2024
scenes.question: Can exact visits and missing station-years be shown without visually implying continuous coverage?

scenes.title: Seasonal monitoring windows
scenes.question: Does a coverage renderer make clustered sampling seasons and a station-specific gap visible without suggesting year-round effort?

scenes.title: Sparse reservoir oxygen observations
scenes.question: Can contextual bands aid interpretation of sparse observations without being mistaken for regulatory thresholds or continuous data?
